SourceFile
  QualifiedPackage consumer.enums
  ImportStar Local upstream.enums.*
  ImportExact Local upstream.enums.Choice as ReusedChoice
  private enum LocalChoice<T>
    Empty
    Pair(T, T?)
    Box(Choice<T>)
  public fun exercise<T>(seed: T, read: (T) -> Int): Int
    val local: LocalChoice<T>
      MethodCall Pair
        Var LocalChoice
        Var seed
        Call Some
          Var seed
    val first
      WhenExpression
        Var local
        arm Pair(value, Some(other))
          Binary Sub
            Binary Add
              Call read
                Var value
              Call read
                Var other
            IntLiteral 42
        else
          IntLiteral 1
    if
      Binary Ne
        Var first
        IntLiteral 42
      return
        IntLiteral 2
    val original: Choice<T>
      MethodCall Item
        Var Choice
        Var seed
    val alias: ReusedChoice<T>
      Call pack
        Var seed
    val wrapped: LocalChoice<T>
      MethodCall Box
        Var LocalChoice
        Var original
    val second
      WhenExpression
        Var wrapped
        arm Box(Choice.Item(value))
          Call read
            Var value
        else
          IntLiteral 3
    if
      Binary Ne
        Var second
        IntLiteral 42
      return
        IntLiteral 4
    if
      Binary Ne
        Call score
          Var alias
          Var read
        IntLiteral 42
      return
        IntLiteral 5
    return
      Var first
  public fun result(): Int
    if
      Binary Ne
        Call exercise<String>
          StringLiteral "value"
          Lambda 0 suspend=false
            param value: _
            IntLiteral 42
        IntLiteral 42
      return
        IntLiteral 1
    if
      Binary Ne
        Call exercise<Unit>
          UnitLiteral
          Lambda 1 suspend=false
            param value: _
            IntLiteral 42
        IntLiteral 42
      return
        IntLiteral 2
    return
      Call exercise<Int>
        IntLiteral 42
        Lambda 2 suspend=false
          param value: _
          Var value
